title: Propionic Acid Preparation
author: Rita M. Graze
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qjjdukn

steps.title: Prepare 2M Sodium Propionate Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 96.06g of Propionic Acid, Sodium salt in 500 mL distilled water to create a 2M Propionic Acid, Sodium Salt solution.

steps.title: Prepare 2M HCl Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the required volume of 2M HCl to be used for the propionic acid conversion.

substeps.instruction: To make 1L of 2M HCl: add 172 mL HCl to 828 mL deionized H2O
To make 0.5L of 2M HCl: add 86 mL HCl to 414 mL deionized H2O

steps.title: Convert Sodium Propionate to 1M Propionic Acid
steps.instruction: Add 500 mL of 2M HCl to the 2M Sodium Propionate solution to produce 1L of 1M Propionic Acid.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the concentration of HCl is equal to the concentration of the dissolved Propionic, Sodium Salt in water if making a different concentration of Propionic Acid

steps.title: Verify and Adjust pH
steps.instruction: Test the pH of the Propionic Acid solution to ensure it is between pH 4.6-4.7.

substeps.instruction: If the pH is above 4.7, titrate the solution with HCl to bring the pH down to specification

steps.title: Dilute and Add to Fly Food
steps.instruction: Dilute the 1M Propionic Acid to the desired concentration and add it to fly food according to the recipe.
